overview: The Tenebrous Borderlands are a volatile frontier shaped by the influence of the Umbral Plains. Resonance storms and shadow anomalies destabilize the region, drawing conflict between the Umbral Vanguard, Shadowed Akheva, and Vampyric Courts.
history: The Borderlands formed when the Umbral Plains expanded centuries ago.
Resonance storms began appearing after the first Akhevan ritual breach.
Vampyric scouts established hidden dens to prey on weakened travelers.
Umbral Vanguard forces constructed stabilizer pylons to contain anomalies.
hooks: A stabilizer pylon fails during a resonance storm.
Akhevan scouts attempt to corrupt an Umbral node.
Vampyric raiders ambush a Vanguard patrol.
A new shadow anomaly appears near the Umbral threshold.
